boundaries: The exact KuKo 2D teacher remains frozen as the regression anchor.
Projection-Locked Lift R01 remains a bridge for validating the 2D interpretation.
Native 3D R03 remains the spatial branching grammar anchor.
Living R04 adds resource flow, root/shoot coupling and a continuous evaluation surface without changing the frozen teachers.
The implicit skin is a derived evaluation surface; the life graph and resource state remain the truth layer.
R04 is not assigned to Pandanus tectorius or any other species.
Generic R04 leaves only prove the organ/resource interface and are not a species leaf model.
Flowers/fruits, true hormone transport, hydraulic resistance and physical wind propagation remain incomplete.
